theoryContent: 实现 FastAPI 风格的异步请求处理：支持并发请求、超时控制和请求排队。
starterCode:
import asyncio
def async_process(requests, timeout): pass
def rate_limiter(max_rps): pass
solutionCode:
import asyncio
def async_process(requests,timeout=5):
    async def proc(req):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        return f"ok:{req}"
    async def run():
        tasks=[asyncio.wait_for(proc(r),timeout=timeout) for r in requests]
        results=await asyncio.gather(*tasks,return_exceptions=True)
        return [r if not isinstance(r,Exception) else f"timeout:{r}" for r in results]
    return asyncio.run(run())
def rate_limiter(max_rps=10):
    tokens=max_rps
    def check():
        nonlocal tokens
        if tokens<=0:return False
        tokens-=1;return True
    return check
